name: Prometheus
description: Reads what Prometheus already knows about the machines in this installation, and attaches it to the customer, service and invoice each one belongs to.

config.label: Prometheus address
config.hint: Where the HTTP API answers, for example https://prometheus.internal:9090.

config.label: Label carrying the host
config.hint: Which label names the machine a series belongs to. Prometheus calls it instance; some setups relabel it to host or node.

config.label: A reading is stale after (seconds)
config.hint: Your scrape interval, roughly. A reading older than this is drawn as stale rather than as fact.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A monitoring system that is down must not become an operator staring at a spinner.
